_description: Fallback prompt templates for orchestration escalation. Used when LLM-generated dynamic prompt is unavailable.
primary: Continue the current gate workflow and focus on closing pending criteria with existing agent assignment.
fallback: Split failing scope by module or requirement, switch reviewer+solver agent pairing, and re-run only impacted checks.
last_chance: Apply a non-overlapping alternative strategy once, record precise deltas, and prepare concise user escalation context if this attempt fails.
user_escalation: Automatic retries are exhausted. Ask the user for explicit direction with failure summary, attempted strategies, and recommended options.
